description:
Scope: planning handoff only. Owner exclusively edits test/zaq/engine/conversations/transcript_history_test.exs; do not edit canonical_history_capture_test.exs, history_ingress_test.exs, production, or docs for this issue. Parent runs mix q and targeted --cover; no full suite/coveralls in this task. Source: lib/zaq/engine/conversations/transcript_history.ex, missed 40,175,327,353,440,481-483,548,562,580,584,589,635,648,658,718,747,767,896,959,984-985,1065,1077,1082. Recheck line alignment before implementation. Tests-first, no production seam solely for coverage.

Functional spec/tests to add before implementation; all through real Conversations context or TranscriptHistory's documented internal public boundary when no context delegate exists. Each case below states expected observable behavior and target line(s):
1. 40 capture/3 rejects wrong Facts type, attrs non-map, or source non-map with {:error,:invalid_request}; no row written. 580 append invalid UUID with maps -> {:error,:not_found}; 584 append valid UUID with non-map attrs/source -> {:error,:invalid_request}; 589 missing but valid UUID -> transaction {:error,:not_found}, no rows. 648 list_admin(valid UUID, non-keyword opts) -> {:error,:not_found}; 635/658 list_admin valid restricted legacy transcript associated with persisted Conversation and exact legacy resource coordinate returns bounded messages; malformed coordinate or nonexistent conversation fails closed. Assert non-admin list still denies legacy. Note list_admin is INTERNAL and caller must check current super-admin; do not suggest exposing it to BO callers.
2. 175 create two otherwise eligible legacy user messages with same external ID in query scope (if allowed by DB uniqueness), then capture -> {:error,:source_conflict}, no new association; check duplicate feasibility first. 327 Facts.strategy error in capture_targets after root Facts.new+Strategy.association_targets succeeds appears unreachable; verify with Facts contract, do not mutate production to force it. 353 deleting the just-resolved transcript between ensure_transcript and FOR UPDATE requires precise competing transaction and could deadlock/flap; no sleep or race-only test. Record blocker.
3. 440 associate_prepared/2 with persisted Message metadata delivery_confirmation and fixed target id but conflicting receipt channel/provider or wrong stored resource -> {:error,:source_scope_mismatch}, no association or position increment. Test a valid confirmation separately to show contrast. 481 preinsert transcript at strategy-derived scope_key with conflicting immutable coordinate, capture -> {:error,:source_scope_mismatch}; ensure branch actually passes through insert_transcript rather than early ensure_transcript existing branch. 482 only reachable after successful insert with missing subsequent SELECT (concurrent delete/trigger) and 483 only when a strategy-derived target insert fails changeset/FK under validated Facts/People; establish legitimate deterministic fixture or mark blocked, no database mocking. 548/562 grant failure branches: after valid Person locks and valid resource determine whether Permissions.grant can fail deterministically through legitimate public inputs/constraints; otherwise classify as unreachable under current contract. Verify transactional rollback of transcript/message/grants if feasible; never mock Permissions.
4. 718 list/read or append a transcript whose connector is missing, has wrong provider/kind, or was disabled; assert :source_scope_mismatch for invalid connector and that archived read remains permitted but write refused. 747 persist a schema-valid legacy strategy transcript with retrieval connector and attempt list_admin -> {:error,:not_found}; fresh Person list returns :unauthorized before resource check, so legacy malformed-resource fallback may need a reachable admin fixture. 767 create valid child transcript, remove parent only if FK allows; if FK prevents deletion, use mismatched parent strategy/resource instead to exercise matching_parent? false, and report 767 unreachability. 896 prepare_execution_response for existing user/assistant matching execution pair, source receipt, and conversation with nonnil but different channel_config_id; assert :invalid_history_source or :unavailable_history_input as appropriate to actual public entry and no source binding. If call requires transcript placement, seed it and assert negative versus matching-config case. 959 pass existing_message_id for a canonical Message without Conversation (nullable conversation_id), and valid capture/append context -> :source_conflict without adoption/placement.
5. 984-985 insert_or_reuse_message uses Repo.insert on_conflict:nothing then get_by on same unique key inside transaction. nil fetch or insert error appears impossible with valid changeset, DB consistency and unique identity; investigate constraints/transaction semantics first, do not inject Repo mocks or force arbitrary DB errors. 1065 append attrs attachments: nil/map/other non-list -> [] on stored message and read projection. 1077 append descriptor with nonnegative integer size -> persisted/read sanitized {size}; test invalid/negative size excluded. 1082 mixed attachments containing non-map, empty map, valid descriptor -> only allowlisted descriptor survives; assert raw/private/nested fields absent from persisted and read messages. Use distinct external IDs so replay comparison does not mask projection.

Fixtures/helpers: reuse existing person/1, config/0, transcript/3, source/2, append/5; canonical_history_capture_test.exs facts/4, source/2, message/2, admission examples (lines ~475, 605, 830, 900, 1017) as pattern references but do not edit that file. Add local minimal Facts.new or struct! builder only if repeated; construct persisted Conversation and Message via existing Conversations admission or changesets, not hidden fixture state. For legacy/admin inspect ChannelHistoryAdmin/legacy snapshot fixture before setup. Direct targeted Repo inserts only to arrange malformed-but-schema-valid persisted scopes, not as public operation replacements. Unique config/person IDs; use Zaq.DataCase sandbox. Existing TranscriptHistoryTest is async:false: retain that for DB process coordination; no app env, global Mox, fixed process names or network. No mock needed: Ecto, Permissions, Strategy, ChannelConfig remain real. Any concurrency test only if deterministic via monitored Task, sandbox allow and explicit observable barrier, never sleep/poll. No new E2E (no UI journey).

Property assessment: existing recipient ordering/idempotent replay properties already cover normalization. Add focused bounded StreamData property for attachment descriptor sanitization/permission-default only if meaningful varied inputs beyond the concrete security examples and without excessive DB loops; otherwise explain why existing properties plus concrete negative cases suffice. Security: nil/missing Person must never authorize reads; no shortcut via owner or administrative projection. Assert exact {:error,reason}, UUIDs, positions, grant unchanged, private fields omitted and rollback row counts as relevant.

Validation handoff (parent owns execution): run ONLY this isolated test file and targeted --cover against TranscriptHistory, then mix q per issue lifecycle; no full suite or coveralls. Compare uncovered line report to every item; mark truly unreachable lines as blockers with supporting guard/constraint evidence, not manufactured tests. Review diff for no weakened assertions, accidental shared helper edits, or production test-only seams. Action reuse: not applicable; tests only, no executable operation, contract, consumer or tool exposure change. Docs: none (test-only); record reachability exceptions in this issue, not a policy edit. Dependency graph: single test-surface issue, no new dependencies; follow-up production debt only if a reachable defect is demonstrated.
title: [coverage] Plan TranscriptHistory missed-line regression tests
